dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: The mid-lateral flank displays several prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped structures. These feature a high-contrast gradient transition from the dark charcoal-grey base coat to high-intensity light-grey perimeters. The interior regions of these rings show a diffuse, darker gradient relative to their bright outer boundaries.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: There is a moderate spatial density of asymmetrical, solid light-pixel clusters localized along the lower lateral line and toward the posterior. These blobs lack an internal gradient and exhibit uniform high-intensity pixel concentration at their cores.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most prominent macro-annuli on the central flank form a scalene triangle. A series of smaller high-intensity blobs establishes a longitudinal spatial relationship extending posteriorly towards the flipper region.
